findings.summary: Compares cart.subtotal_cents() (cents) against FREE_SHIPPING_THRESHOLD (50, whole dollars), so carts of 50 cents or more get free shipping and the $7.99 charge is almost never applied; the new tests only use a $120 cart and miss it.

judge.reason: Same cents-vs-dollars unit mismatch against FREE_SHIPPING_THRESHOLD causing near-universal free shipping.
